svg.title: Work: service desk, company-wide SSO, documents and org chart, production dashboard, HR portal, marketing analytics — shipped with Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS and Azure

g.text: SLA-driven tickets, a customer portal, chat bots and a
RAG assistant over the knowledge base.
OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect provider: SMS, email and
Apple sign-in, anti-abuse limits, an SDK.
Approval workflows, real-time chat and an
infinite-canvas org structure. Migrated to AWS.
A drag-and-drop kanban for the assembly line with
Employee records, leave and automated greetings, with
sign-in through the company SSO only.
Daily data from ad and email platforms, period

svg.text: EVERY SERVICE SHIPS THE SAME WAY
